summary: Today's briefing highlights significant legal rulings impacting reservation policies and transparency in corruption cases, alongside developments in retail and economic agreements.

bullets.text: Karnataka High Court struck down a law enhancing SC/ST reservation, ruling total quota exceeds the 50% cap.
Madras High Court ruled that DVAC cannot claim blanket exemption from the RTI Act in corruption cases.
India's office hubs, like Gurugram and Mumbai, are transforming into retail hotspots catering to employees.
SLN Coffee plans to invest approximately Rs 2,500 crore over ten years, targeting Rs 1,500 crore revenue next fiscal.
UK-India CETA aims to enhance economic ties, focusing on trade and investment opportunities.
